summary: A staked claim's release unlinks whatever is at the path, so a second drop deletes the claim a later holder took

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

acceptance: release removes only the file its own stake created, and only once, so neither tip-claim drop needs a held flag beside it to stay off a later holder's claim
tests: a second release of a staked claim leaves a later holder's claim file standing
pins: a staked claim's first release removes the claim file it created
notes: Verified this tick: release unlinks `target` unconditionally (`src/pidClaim.ts:209`), so the interface doc's "Idempotent" (`:154`) holds only against its own absence. `dropLock` gates the loop-lock unlink on `lockHeld` but leaves `tipClaim?.release()` ungated (`src/cli.ts:1251`); the bare-tick sibling gates on `claimHeld` and names this exact hazard at `:1046`. Detection one sibling performs, re-derived beside the mechanism rather than in it.
